text:
maria-chen: quick sync — console observability roadmap, need owners + decisions for:
- trace hook ownership for service-side instrumentation (sampling + span tagging)
- error-analysis views (grouping, user impact metric)
- retention milestone: do we keep traces for 30d or 90d for high-cardinality endpoints?

jamal-singh: I'm owner for trace hooks but juggling infra sprint. Can we split ownership? I can own the instrumentation PRs (agent changes) if eng-runtime owns the collector and sampling config.

kevin-obrien: can take collector/sampling. timeline: can do initial canary by Wed (2033456800). For 30d vs 90d — need cost estimates from finance and perf numbers. Also need to verify large payload handling for KV cache and trace payloads.

sara_ng: SRE + alerts: error-analysis views need an "impact_score" field we discussed. If retention is 90d, alert noise may increase; recommend 30d default, with extended retention for a small set of high-value services.

maria-chen: OK sounds reasonable. Action items so we're all clear:
- jamal -> open instrumentation PRs by EOD Monday
- kevin -> collector + sampling config canary on Wed
- sara -> draft alert rules for impact_score (low/med/high) and post here

deploy-bot: PR #5042 merged into feature/obs-v2 at 2033456820

jamal-singh: noted, will tag reviewers: @kevin-obrien @sara_ng

kevin-obrien: quick note — dashboards: the error-analysis UI needs a new top-level filter `service_type`. I'll add to UI ticket and link the wireframes.

maria-chen: thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap doc (link: https://redwood.docs/obs/roadmap) and ping Legal for retention policy clarification. If no objections by Friday we'll adopt 30d default and roll canary.

jamal-singh: +1

sara_ng: :thumbsup:

kevin-obrien: :rocket:
